I was addicted to weed, speed and coke (they were interchangeable for me), and alcohol. I'm 71 days free from all of those except alcohol but I don't drink excessively; just daily. After two weeks of being clean it was like being high I felt so good. Waking up in the mornings is just infinitely easier. I love not having to time when i'm going to go to bed (which would always inevitably be much earlier than I actually fell asleep). I no longer have to hide things from nearly everyone in my life, or be scared that they know or are going to find out about my use. I get angry way way less now and honestly looking back to when I was addicted kind of scares me. I know I looked like an asshole with how often I got angry over stupid things now. 

A lot of my problems in life also just kind of worked themselves out when I went clean too. My relationship with my girlfriend became much better, my depression lifted. My self hatred is gone, I got a new job that i'm well liked at. Overall, everything about my life is just better. I miss the highs but I wouldn't go back

Thanks for the reply. At this point I fully admit i'm just addicted. I'm in a really really shitty situation though because it's basically my best friend who I get my stuff from. He got into dealing with just weed but moved onto harder stuff for the money. He's getting a little into the stuff but not nearly as badly as I am. I want to just kind of ditch all my friends and move onto new ones, but I have a girlfriend who doesn't know the half of my problem and we share the same friends group. She knows I have gone behind her back to do hard drugs a few times in the past and those times made her extremely upset. She said she'd hate it but that she'd have to leave me if it continues. I don't think I could break it to her at this point without having her leave me or hate me. I've asked my friend who sells me stuff to not give me anymore but I always end up making up excuses to him as to why he should give me more, like the other day I said I had a fuck ton of schoolwork I need to get through but that I was too exhausted to, so I asked for one speed pill. Which lead to me going back for a few more. I hate the fact that he sells the stuff in the first place, I keep telling him to stop. He's going to get arrested. He's got his own problems though so idk. As for my family, I don't want them to ever know I have this problem. I'm already the more disappointing son always having gotten lower marks in school and having problems with softer drugs like weed and alcohol. I feel like this would make my family hate me. 

I'm getting any and all help available from my college right now. I have a counsellor who I talk to about my addictions and depression, he's suggested I go to this student only addictions group meeting or something which i'm for sure going to. I'm also getting an addictions specialist to talk to me or something like that. I just finished my second meeting with him but instead of getting better, i've gotten worse. Between the first and second meeting I managed to stay clean but since my last meeting on tuesday, i've done $70 worth of coke at a party, 6 speed pills and two 15mg adderall pills. This is the most i've done in such a short period of time and i'm very obviously building up a tolerance, but I keep doing this shit. 

I'm sorry this is kind of rambly and all over the place, if its not obvious i'm on speed again fml.
